scope: The standing Birch Memorial Clock Tower in Ipoh, including the stepped plinth, square panelled shaft, four dark clock faces, open belfry with terracotta figures, smaller open lantern, dome and finial.
geometryBasis: OpenStreetMap tower node 4540711689 fixes the position, and the adjacent plaza line fixes the local directions. The square base and orientation of architectural faces are reconstructed from the image and plaza plan.
sectionBasis: Estimated proportions from the single cleared exterior photo, with a 1.9812 m main bell as an interior scale control. The base follows the untouched plaza terrain. Shared plaster and painted trim reproduce the strong pale-and-dark clock tiers.
limitations: The mapped point fixes the position. Footprint width, overall height and exact orientation use photographic and site estimates.
The four painted panels and statues are simplified geometric representations. Bell details and obscured elevations are approximate. The tower retains a fixed illustrative clock reading.
The original elevation field is preserved. Immediate plinth contact remains approximate at the terrain source resolution.

sources.basis: Ipoh City Council lists the Birch Memorial Clock Tower on its heritage trail.
Tourism Malaysia dates the tower to 1909 and identifies the four terracotta figures around the belfry and the painted figure panels.
Local archive records the square tower, four painted panels, a 6 ft 6 in main bell and four smaller bells, and the disappeared bust in the north-facing niche.
The archived contemporary written report locates the panel approximately 30 ft above the lower street.
